findings.title: Cleanup ticker interval silently changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute
findings.body: The ticker in Run was changed from time.Minute * 10 to time.Minute * 1. This is unrelated to the annotation deadlock fix described in the PR and is not mentioned in the description. It makes every cleanup job (snapshots, dashboard versions, images, invites, short URLs, query history, annotations) run ten times as often, which is a production behaviour change. It looks like a leftover from debugging and should be reverted unless it is intentional and documented.

findings.title: Routine cleanup progress is logged at Error level, including full ID lists, on every batch
findings.body: In CleanAnnotations (and CleanOrphanedAnnotationTags) the normal per-batch progress messages ("Annotations to clean by time", "cleaned annotations by time", "Tags to clean", "cleaned tags", and the by-count equivalents) are emitted with r.log.Error. Successful routine work is not an error, so this will flood error logs and trip error-based alerting on every cleanup cycle. The ids slice is also logged in full: with batch sizes up to 32767 that is a very large log line per batch. These should be Debug (or Info) and should not dump the ID list. The "err" field is also always nil at the first log call, since err was just checked and returned, so it is misleading.
